Reserved bare-metal Apple Silicon VM acceptance (2270/1875/2060 VM subset)

All cases start NOT_RUN. This procedure creates only disposable WendyOS VMs
inside a fresh private fixture root; it does not install/update firmware or
change host networking/virtualization. Use a Mac explicitly reserved by its
owner, on an ordinary account, physically verify its serial/asset label and
record those with the owner and time. Confirm it is the bare-metal macOS host,
not a nested VM or container. Do not run against anyone's existing VM store.
Source does not infer physical ownership from a model string.

1. Check out the exact reviewed WendyOS candidate, record git rev-parse HEAD,
   and ensure the lifecycle source files have no unexpected changes. Build the
   actual CLI and commands suite using the ordinary repository prerequisites:
     go build -o /private/tmp/RESERVED-OUTPUT/wendy ./go/cmd/wendy
     go test -c -o /private/tmp/RESERVED-OUTPUT/commands.test ./go/internal/cli/commands
   Choose a fresh owner-controlled output directory. No installer/root commands
   are needed. Have the owner provide an ordinary native QEMU installation and
   matching padded ARM64 UEFI firmware. Record its package/version. If missing,
   stop for normal owner-managed setup rather than changing it during rehearsal.

2. Generate the admission record on that exact reserved host/account/boot:
     python3 .github/scripts/test-macos-vm-lifecycle.py \
       --cli /private/tmp/RESERVED-OUTPUT/wendy \
       --test-binary /private/tmp/RESERVED-OUTPUT/commands.test \
       --write-reservation /private/tmp/RESERVED-OUTPUT/reservation.json
   This reads only identity/version/files and records UUID, UID, hostname, boot,
   ARM64, exact CLI/test/Python/QEMU/firmware/source hashes. It never creates or
   boots a VM and leaves hardware_execution=not_run. Inspect every field and
   match UUID/account/boot to the physically reserved Mac. The owner then writes
   exactly this owner_confirmation value in that same JSON:
     I reserve this bare-metal Mac for the owned WendyOS VM lifecycle
   Keep the original generated record and reviewed amended hash as evidence.
   Any host reboot or binary/source change requires fresh admission and review.

3. Require12GiB free in /tmp and an uninterrupted35-minute reserved window.
   Inspect the exact published guest pin in test-windows-vm-boot.py (vm-arm64
   0.20.2, size582023203, SHA256f9f3e3ac18936230d1f72a38a097ba3bae5f7e37ccaba663b20dbfcc53849ea3).
   The wrapper validates bytes before boot. The guest is an actual released
   WendyOS image; only the nonce HTTP test app is locally built. No credential
   or host directory is shared into the guest. Run:
     python3 .github/scripts/test-macos-vm-lifecycle.py \
       --cli /private/tmp/RESERVED-OUTPUT/wendy \
       --test-binary /private/tmp/RESERVED-OUTPUT/commands.test \
       --reserved-host /private/tmp/RESERVED-OUTPUT/reservation.json \
       --output /private/tmp/RESERVED-OUTPUT/hvf-evidence
   It must report actual production accel=hvf, cancellation while the guest CPU
   is paused, recovery of that same QEMU, real OCI app nonce/counters, graceful
   stop, the same owned disk inode/Agent hostname/port and a new guest boot_id with working forwarded
   HTTP after restart. The original missing-forwarding control must fail only
   its named real app readiness boundary. Unexpected failure stays pending.

4. Review evidence.json plus normal/control/create/remove/console logs. Both
   phases must have actual inherited run-lock drain and CLI removal, no skip,
   panic, unknown drain, or forced-deadline evidence. Hardware execution becomes
   executed_pending_operator_review only; the owner records pass/fail against
   the exact source/host/guest identity, with no claim about other Macs, Windows,
   Cloud, UI, or public enrollment. Preserve outputs outside Git; no screenshots
   or binary disk images belong in commits.

5. On interruption or unknown cleanup, keep the printed owned /tmp/wv-* root.
   Never kill a numeric PID from old state.json, remove another VM, or delete
   disks before drain. The wrapper attempts exact QMP quit and inherited flock
   verification. If that fails, the owner must inspect that exact private socket
   and process live identity, or reboot the reserved Mac, then confirm no writer
   remains before removing the retained owned directory. Record incomplete
   cleanup as failure. No automated global process/cache/image cleanup exists.
